turns.assessment: The critical equipment alarm is localized to trx.och30.z, and the simultaneous loss of its receive monitoring and of och30 at the far-end receiver matches the documented bidirectional signature of a card failure. Channel power disappears along S11→S12→S15 while the amplifiers and other channels show no corresponding change, strongly excluding a span, amplifier, or ROADM-wide failure.

proposals.rationale: O1 directly reports EQPT_CARD_FAIL on this unit. Its receiver loses valid OSNR, BER, and power, while its transmitted och30 channel is lost at S12, S15, and the far-end receiver. This is precisely the documented CARD_FAIL behavior; unchanged line amplifiers and neighboring channels argue against an optical-line cause.
